lines: {target}? Bright trunks can make shadows easy to miss. I would save bread for the road home.
If anyone heads for Birch Forest, tell them: Do not let the pretty light lower your guard. I will be at the fields.
White bark shows marks, but not always danger. I will remember that when I put bread aside.
Birch Forest is no small story. A full belly is not the same as safety.
I will remember Birch Forest as a pale forest with quiet steps under it. I will keep bread aside for the road.
